mapper.update: UPDATE agent_run SET intent=#{intent},intent_confidence=#{confidence}, intent_reason_code=#{reasonCode} WHERE run_id=#{runId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO retrieval_trace (run_id,standalone_query_hash,bm25_status,vector_status, rerank_status,rerank_degraded,grounded_threshold,candidate_scores_json,selected_count, retrieval_status,duration_ms,created_at) VALUES (#{runId},#{queryHash},#{bm25Status},#{vectorStatus},#{rerankStatus},#{degraded}, #{threshold},CAST(#{scoresJson} AS JSON),#{selectedCount},#{retrievalStatus},#{durationMs},#{createdAt})
